name: kanban
description: A kanban side pane: Active (Backlog, Human, Claude) and Inactive (Done, Cancelled, Suspended) sections over GitHub Projects or local .kanban/ cards.

backend.title: Card backend (default: auto)
backend.description: Where cards live: GitHub, local .kanban/ files, or auto to use GitHub when a board is found.

claudeLimit.title: Claude limit (default: 1)
claudeLimit.description: How many cards Claude works on at once; 0 means no limit.

reconcile.title: Reconcile at turn end (default: on)
reconcile.description: At the end of a turn, remind Claude to hand off or move a card it left in Claude.
